name: I Formation - Z Left - 33 Handoff

QB.rule: Open left, hand to the tailback, then fake the boot right. It holds the backside end.

TB.rule: Take the handoff downhill between the center and the left guard, following the fullback. Do not bounce it.

coaching_points: This is the iso: the fullback smashes the linebacker in the hole, the tailback runs right off his hip.
The hole is the A-gap — between the center and the left guard. If the tailback bounces, the play is dead.
The fullback's man is whoever shows in that gap, not a man he picks before the snap.
